name: m06-6.7-linux
title: Lab 6.7: a two-tenant RAG bot; poison it, leak across tenants, catch it guessing, fix all three, prove it; optional real models through Ollama
before: curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh -o ollama-install.sh && sh ollama-install.sh && rm -f ollama-install.sh
sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl enable --now ollama || (setsid nohup ollama serve >/tmp/ollama.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &)
for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/version && break; sleep 2; done

steps.label: Real vulnerable
steps.type: .venv/bin/python rag_app.py --mode vulnerable --llm ollama --embed ollama "How do I get a refund?"

steps.label: Real safe
steps.type: .venv/bin/python rag_app.py --mode safe --llm ollama --embed ollama --min-score 0.5 "How do I get a refund?"
